dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Presence of at least five distinct, high-luminance circular clusters within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily distributed in the lower and central quadrants of the visible fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch at the dorsal fin apex, characterized by a deep indentation and the presence of green and brownish-yellow organic epibiont growth or macro-algae colonization.
